label: UI · click
brief: Soft mechanical click. Card-flip ink. 80-120ms. Used for menu navigation and card plays.

label: UI · back / cancel
brief: Softer click with a low pitch descent. The 'no, not that' sound. 120ms.

label: UI · unlock chime
brief: Small bright two-note ping. Used when a cipher reveal, music track, or codex page unlocks. 600ms.

label: Scene · advance
brief: Page-turn / inhalation. The breath between beats. 400ms.

label: Scene · choice appears
brief: Slow rising hush of attention — the choice list emerging. 800ms. Mood: the room narrowing.

label: Lore · token revealed
brief: Small bright ping, like a paper-thin glass tap. Used when a lore token is collected. 600ms.

label: Dice · gauntlet threshold roll
brief: Soft tumble against ceramic. Three to five dice on a formica counter. 700ms.

label: Card · play (gauntlet)
brief: Quiet card flip / soft thump. Card laid flat on the counter. 250ms.

label: Diner · brass call bell
brief: Brass call bell, single ring. Slight reverb of an interior room. 1.5s decay.

label: Diner · gravity card draw
brief: Low scrape — the room reaching for you. Felt-on-felt + a single low cello note. 800ms.

label: Diner · visitor arrives
brief: Front door bell, thin and brassy. Then a half-second of cooler outside air through the open door. 1s.

label: Diner · visitor connection
brief: Two-note rising chime. Warm, brief, intimate. 800ms.

label: Diner · visitor claimed / walks out
brief: Dropped tone, brass cooling. A held breath let out wrong. 1.2s.

label: Item · pickup
brief: Paper rustle / cloth fold / coin tap. Sub-cued depending on item kind. 250ms.

label: Sting · win (LEAP)
brief: Held breath releasing. A single rising chord that opens, then resolves. 4s.

label: Sting · loss (reversed)
brief: Falling tone, then silence. Not dramatic — settling. 4s.

label: Gauntlet · lore token revealed
brief: Small bright ping, like a paper-thin glass tap. Played when a lore token is collected during a gauntlet run. 600ms.
